decision: No demonstrated algorithmic defect in this numerical export; retain original algorithms and report remaining scientific limits.
scientific_limits: - The refinement norm is one selected off-axis target, not a global error bound or a verified asymptotic order.
- The aligned planar front is a manufactured case. No monodomain/bidomain tissue solver was rerun or established equivalent.
- Noiseless observations generated by the same model demonstrate computational recovery, not independent biological identifiability, noise robustness, or uniqueness on patient data.

- Independent patient activation-time maps, appropriate acquisition metadata and physiological ECG/reference-solver comparisons remain required. Larger anisotropic/global-norm and independently controlled mesh/time studies are useful next verification steps.
